title: Backend API and CLI Integration
objective: Expose the R10.8.2 engine (root, calibration, encode, decode, inspect, batch, receipt) through the real application boundary: a pure-stdlib argparse CLI printing deterministic JSON and returning a process exit code (no web framework; fastapi/flask unavailable).

repository_truth.head: de620bb
reused_engine: cwatlas.r1082.root_certificate / calibration_freeze / geocode_forward / geocode_inverse / result_states / overlay_spec - NOT reimplemented

implementation.web_framework: NONE (CLI-only application boundary; no network, no server)
implementation.output: deterministic JSON (sort_keys) with governance seals on every payload
implementation.output_firewall: cli._guard_no_measured_leak refuses to emit any payload whose evidence_class is MEASURED/REPLICATED or containing SOURCE_ORIGIN_VALIDATED

claims.statement: A pure-stdlib argparse CLI exposes the locked-root engine (root certificate, frozen calibration, forward/inverse source geocoders, structural inspect, batch decode, evidence receipts); every subcommand prints deterministic JSON, carries the governance seals, and returns a process exit code.

negative_results: No web framework is used or required: fastapi/flask are unavailable and out of scope; the backend API is the CLI boundary.

The CLI never emits a candidate as MEASURED or REPLICATED and never emits a validated source origin; the output firewall routes any such leak through claims.refuse_candidate_as_measured / refuse_source_origin_validated.

A candidate is at most CALIBRATED_CANDIDATE: an uncalibrated decode yields a region or alias set, never a false single pin; a foreign-body vector is typed out of scope, not force-decoded; a malformed vector is a typed INVALID, not a crash.
Tranche T07 modules are imported lazily and guarded, so the CLI runs and its tests pass whether or not the sibling tranche has landed.
Locked decisions are not reopened and no frozen parameter is retuned in the CLI.
privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public routes (e.g. 165876523), the synthetic public Stonehenge coordinate, and opaque ids only; no private path literals, no identity tokens, no raw private vectors or narrative
